metadata.title: Runaway and Hypervelocity Stars from Compact Object Encounters in Globular Clusters

notes: No eligible individual stars: the paper analyzes synthetic stellar-ejecta populations rather than selecting or following up named stars. S5-HVS1 is mentioned only as a previously known hypervelocity star in the introduction, not analyzed here (T:p1-b7), and the observational catalog comparisons are population-level without individual stellar identifiers.
